chunks.text: Today we will talk about Nepal.
Nepal is a beautiful country in South Asia.
It has high mountains, kind people and rich culture.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Nepal?
Nepal is in South Asia.
It is between China and India.
It has no sea, but it has very high mountains.
Nepal is home to the Himalayas, the tallest mountain range in the world.
What is the capital city of Nepal?
The capital city of Nepal is Kathmandu.
Kathmandu is busy, colorful and full of history.
There are many temples, markets and narrow streets.
Other cities in Nepal include Pokhara, a peaceful city near lakes and mountains.
Lalitpur and Bhaktapur, old cities with beautiful buildings.
How many people live in Nepal?
About 30 million people live in Nepal.
Some live in cities, but many people live in villages, hills or mountain areas.
Nepal is a country of many cultures, languages and traditions.
What language do people speak in Nepal?
The official language is Nepali.
Nepali is used in schools, offices and newspapers.
But people also speak many other languages like Mithili, Bojpuri, Tamang and more.
Nepal has over 120 languages.
Many people also speak English, especially in cities and tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Nepal?
The weather is different in each part of the country.
In the mountains, it is cold and there is snow.
In the plains, it is warm or hot, especially in summer.
In Kathmandu, the weather is mild.
Nepal has four seasons.
There is also a monsoon season in summer with heavy rain.
What does Nepal look like?
Nepal is full of natural beauty.
You can see mountains, including Mount Everest, the highest mountain in the world, green hills and valleys, rivers and lakes, forests and farms.
Many people visit Nepal to go trekking, climbing or to enjoy nature.
What animals live in Nepal?
Nepal has many wild animals.
Tigers, rhinos, leopards, elephants, red pandas.
There are also monkeys, yaks, buffalo and deer.
In the Himalayas, you can see snow leopards and Himalayan goats.
Nepal has national parks to protect its wildlife.
What do people eat in Nepal?
Nepali food is simple, tasty and healthy.
People eat rice, lentils and vegetables.
Dalbat, a meal with rice, lentil soup and side dishes.
Momos, steamed or fried dumplings with meat or vegetables.
Roti, flatbread.
Pickles, spicy and sour.
People often eat with their hands using the right hand.
Food is often homemade and shared with family.
What do people drink in Nepal?
People drink tea, usually with milk and sugar.
Water often boiled or filtered.
Lassi, a yogurt drink.
Juice from fruits like mango or orange.
In the mountains, people also drink butter tea, which is warm and salty.
What is life like in Nepal?
Life in Nepal can be busy in cities and peaceful in villages.
People go to school or work during the day.
In the evening, they spend time with family.
Many people work in farming, tourism, shops and markets, handicrafts.
People value respect, hospitality and tradition.
What are some holidays and traditions in Nepal?
Nepal has many festivals from different cultures and religions.
Some important holidays are Dashain, the biggest Hindu festival with family gatherings and blessings.
Tihar, the festival of lights similar to Diwali.
Holi, the festival of colors with music and water.
Budha Jayanti, the birthday of Lord Buddha.
Indra Jatra, a traditional festival in Kathmandu.
People wear traditional clothes, sing songs and dance.
They also share food and light candles or lamps.
Some fun facts about Nepal.
Nepal has eight of the ten highest mountains in the world.
Mount Everest is called Sagarmatha in Nepali and Chomalungma in Tibetan.
The flag of Nepal is not a rectangle, it has two triangles.
Nepal is the birthplace of Buddha.
Many tourists visit for hiking, temples and adventure.
Now you know many things about Nepal.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the mountains, animals, food and culture.
Great work.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
